April.definition: The fourth month of the year, after March and before May.

August.definition: The eighth month of the year, after July and before September.

be.definition: To exist or to have a quality or state; also used with another verb to form continuous and passive tenses.

December.definition: The twelfth and last month of the year, after November.

every.definition: Each one of a group, without any exception; used to show how often something happens.

February.definition: The second month of the year, after January and before March.

for.definition: Used to show the purpose of something, who receives it, or how long something lasts.

Friday.definition: The day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday.

have to.definition: To be obliged to do something; must.

January.definition: The first month of the year, after December and before February.

July.definition: The seventh month of the year, after June and before August.

June.definition: The sixth month of the year, after May and before July.

look.definition: To direct your eyes towards someone or something in order to see them; to seem or appear.

May.definition: The fifth month of the year, after April and before June.

Monday.definition: The day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday.

October.definition: The tenth month of the year, after September and before November.

our.definition: Belonging to or connected with us, the speaker and one or more other people.

Saturday.definition: The day of the week after Friday and before Sunday.

September.definition: The ninth month of the year, after August and before October.

Sunday.definition: The day of the week after Saturday and before Monday.

their.definition: Belonging to or connected with them, or with a person whose gender is not stated.

Thursday.definition: The day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday.

Tuesday.definition: The day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday.

Wednesday.definition: The day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday.

your.definition: Belonging to or connected with the person or people you are talking to.

according to.definition: As stated by someone or shown by something; in agreement with.

instead of.definition: In place of someone or something else.

touch.definition: To put your hand or another part of your body on something; to affect someone's feelings.

used to.definition: Describes something that happened regularly or was true in the past but no longer is.

tight.definition: Fixed or fastened firmly; fitting closely, with little or no room to spare.

hell.definition: In some religions, the place where bad people are punished after death; a very unpleasant experience.

phase.definition: A stage in a process of change or development.

net.definition: Material made of threads or ropes tied together with spaces between them, used for catching or covering; short for the Internet.

o’clock.definition: Used after a number from one to twelve to show the exact hour on a clock.

Wi-Fi™.definition: Any of several standards for short-range wireless data transmission (IEEE 802.11).
